evidence.ref: .warp/fleet.py fills the WorkerSpawner start seam with a REAL worktree-isolated in-session start. WorktreeInSessionStart.__call__(worker_id, env) provisions a git-worktree-isolated workspace per worker via WorktreeProvisioner.add (an in-line `git worktree add --detach`, _git_worktree running `git worktree` only), dispatches the worker through the injected in-session callback dispatch(worker_id, env, worktree), and returns a retireable handle {worker_id, worktree, worker}. Its .stop(handle) is the InSessionSpawner stop: it stops the worker cooperatively (dispatch_stop) and removes the worktree (WorktreeProvisioner.remove), and InSessionSpawner.retire releases the account. The account's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is threaded into env by InSessionSpawner._assemble_env, so the worker reuses that account's login. make_worktree_in_session_spawner reuses make_in_session_spawner / AccountSpreader (one account per worker), adding no second account or handle implementation. A worker is an in-session worker that dies with the session; nothing detached is started.

scripts/selftest.py WARP-1010 block passes with a fake provisioner (_FakeWorktree) and a fake dispatch over a throwaway accounts root: 'worktree-isolated start provisions a worktree per worker and dispatches in-session', 'the dispatch carries the worker's account CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, scope, and worktree', 'retire stops the in-session worker and removes its worktree (retireable handle)', and 'a worktree fleet run scales to the account count, one account per worker, and drains' (every worker dispatched under its own account, every worktree added then removed). The live worktree/dispatch start is a REFERENCE path, not gate-run.

.warp/fleet.py spawns NO detached, headless, or background process for the worker. grep of the shipped module finds none of Popen, os.fork, os.exec, os.spawn, os.posix_spawn, os.system, setsid, nohup, start_new_session, creationflags, multiprocessing, pty.spawn, or 'claude -p'. The ONLY external program is an in-line synchronous `git worktree` call (subprocess.run(["git", "worktree"] ...) in _git_worktree), and subprocess is imported LAZILY inside that helper (never at module top), exactly the supervisor.py posture (RealSystemctl only ever runs systemctl). The worker launch itself is the injected dispatch(worker_id, env, worktree) seam, not a process this module starts; with no dispatch wired the module honors the same fail-loud boundary it held as a reference before (feedback_no_rogue_processes, PLAN-0007 NG1).

The no-detach boundary has TEETH in the supervisor spawn-on-install style: a selftest predicate _no_detached_worker_spawn(src) over the shipped fleet.py source returns True (no detached/background primitive), and two MUTATIONS turn it RED - appending subprocess.Popen(["claude", "-p", prompt], start_new_session=True) and appending os.system("claude -p work &"). Both mutations make _no_detached_worker_spawn return False, so a future change that slips a detached spawn or a background claude -p into fleet.py fails the gate. The launcher control logic (elastic scaling, one-account-per-worker via AccountSpreader, retire releasing the account) stays gate-tested via the fake spawner (WARP-0707/0902 blocks unchanged); the live in-session start is a reference path not run in the gate.
